messages:
maya: quick sync on org-bound API key handshake RFC follow-up. want to lock migration and runtime checks.
jon: summary: require X-Org + signature for new keys; legacy keys supported during migration window.
rashid: handshake sketch: client sends `Authorization: ApiKey <key_id>`, `X-Org: org_id`, `X-Nonce: n`, `X-Sig: sig(key_id|org_id|n)`. server: lookup key meta, verify sig with derived_pub_key, assert org in org_allowlist.
lina: we need explicit behavior for keys without org_allowlist (legacy). do we accept with warning or reject when org header present?
maya: migration plan: soft-accept legacy keys for 45 days. if request includes org header and key not bound: tag telemetry "unbound_key", add header `X-Auth-Warning` to response. after 45 days block and return 401 unless enterprise exemption.
jon: add canary: start with soft-log checks enabled server-side, 5% traffic. surface counts in console.
rashid: schema change: token table add `org_allowlist` (text array), `derived_pub_key` (text), `kdf_version` (int). backfill job sets org_allowlist=NULL, migration_tag='legacy'.
lina: backfill risks: long running migration locks. implement in batches, use noop lock, and use a flag to skip during maintenance windows.
john: (typo correction) jon: also: caching strategy to avoid DB penalty: cache derived_pub_key and org_allowlist in redis keyed by key_id for 60s. prefetch top-N active keys.
auth-bot: perf sim queued. expected delta: +0.6ms p95 if no cache, +0.1ms with cache. initial extra DB reads ~1.2% under load.
rashid: implementation detail: use HKDF-SHA256 with info = "redwood.org.bind||kdf_v||org_id" to derive per-org key material. store derived_pub_key in hex and kdf_version on token issue.
lina: UX: Console: when creating API key show "Bind to orgs" with multi-select. default behavior: new keys bind to creator's primary org. expose migration status per key.
maya: rollout tasks: 1) migration playbook (owner: lina) 2) DB migration PR + backfill job (owner: rashid) 3) SDK helpers + examples (owner: jon) 4) telemetry/dashboards (owner: maya) 5) sales exceptions flow (owner: jon).
jon: SDK example snippet for callers: ```js
// sign helper
const payload = `${keyId}|${orgId}|${nonce}`
const sig = signWithKey(keySecret, payload)
fetch('/v1/endpoint', { headers: { 'Authorization': `ApiKey ${keyId}`, 'X-Org': orgId, 'X-Nonce': nonce, 'X-Sig': sig } })
```
lina: enterprise ask: some customers use a single key across many orgs. we need an exception flow and longer grace for those tenants.
maya: agreed. sales will provide list; migration playbook will include exception handling and audit.
rashid: rotation model: rotating base secret rotates derived keys. we must include `kdf_version` and support multi-version verification during rotation window.
jon: security note: derivation reduces blast radius. but if base private leaks, all derived are impacted. consider per-operator keypair per org if higher security needed.
maya: decision: proceed with HKDF-derived per-org keys, soft-rollout 45 days, console UX, caching for perf, SDK update. enterprise exceptions handled case-by-case.
auth-bot: perf sim complete: canary at 5% stable after cache changes, posting results to #canary-metrics :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team. next checkpoint Friday on migration playbook. :thumbsup:
